arxiv-2203-09962.title: Randomized Sharpness-Aware Training for Boosting Computational Efficiency in Deep Learning
arxiv-2203-09962.creator: Yang Zhao, Hao Zhang and Xiuyuan Hu
arxiv-2203-09962.description: Abstract By driving models to converge to flat minima, sharpness-aware learning algorithms (such as SAM) have shown the power to achieve state-of-the-art performances. However, these algorithms will generally incur one extra forward-backward propagation at each training iteration, which largely burdens the computation especially for scalable models.

arxiv-2206-08014.title: On Error and Compression Rates for Prototype Rules
arxiv-2206-08014.creator: Omer Kerem, Roi Weiss
arxiv-2206-08014.description: Abstract We study the close interplay between error and compression in the non-parametric multiclass classification setting in terms of prototype learning rules. We focus in particular on a recently proposed compression-based learning rule termed OptiNet ( Kontorovich, Sabato, and Urner 2016 ; Kontorovich, Sabato, and Weiss 2017 ; Hanneke et al. 2021 ) .

arxiv-2301-05305.title: Reinforcement Learning-based Joint Handover and Beam Tracking in Millimeter-wave Networks
arxiv-2301-05305.creator: Sara Khosravi 1 , Hossein S. Ghadikolaei 3 , Jens Zander 1 , and Marina Petrova 1 2
arxiv-2301-05305.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop an algorithm for joint handover and beam tracking in millimeter-wave (mmWave) networks. The aim is to provide a reliable connection in terms of the achieved throughput along the trajectory of the mobile user while preventing frequent handovers. We model the association problem as an optimization problem and propose a reinforcement learning-based solution.

arxiv-2302-14818.title: Symbiotic Dynamics in Living Liquid Crystals
arxiv-2302-14818.creator: Aditya Vats, Pradeep Kumar Yadav, Varsha Banerjee, Sanjay Puri
arxiv-2302-14818.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aditya Vats, Pradeep Kumar Yadav, Varsha Banerjee, Sanjay Puri. An amalgamate of nematic liquid crystals and active matter, referred to as living liquid crystals , is a promising self-healing material with futuristic applications for targeted delivery of information and micro-cargo.

arxiv-2312-15915.title: ChartBench: A Benchmark for Complex Visual Reasoning in Charts
arxiv-2312-15915.creator: Zhengzhuo Xu, Sinan Du, Yiyan Qi, Chengjin Xu, Chun Yuan, Jian Guo
arxiv-2312-15915.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in image understanding and generation. However, current benchmarks fail to accurately evaluate the chart comprehension of MLLMs due to limited chart types and inappropriate metrics. To address this, we propose ChartBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess chart comprehension and data reliability through complex visual reasoning.

arxiv-2410-10351.title: Scaled quantum theory. The bouncing ball problem
arxiv-2410-10351.creator: S. V. Mousavi, S. Miret-Artés
arxiv-2410-10351.description: Abstract Within the so-called scaled quantum theory, the standard bouncing ball problem is analyzed under the presence of a gravitational field and harmonic potential. In this framework, the quantum-classical transition of the density matrix is described by the linear scaled von Neumann equation for mixed states and after it has been particularized to the case of pure states.

arxiv-2412-20527.title: Gravitational Energy Creation in the Sandwich pp-Waves Collision
arxiv-2412-20527.creator: F. L. Carneiro, K. Q. Abbasi
arxiv-2412-20527.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by F. L. Carneiro, K. Q. Abbasi. This article investigates the spacetime of two colliding sandwich gravitational waves, focusing on evaluating gravitational energy before and after the collision. In the framework of the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR), we derive a true energy-momentum tensor for the gravitational waves and integrate it over a finite region of space, obtaining analytical expressions for the energy of each wave and the resulting spacetime.

arxiv-2501-18518.title: Balance Laws and Transport Theorems for Flows with Singular Interfaces
arxiv-2501-18518.creator: Ferdinand Thein, Gerald Warnecke
arxiv-2501-18518.description: Abstract Dedication: This paper is dedicated to the memory of Wolfgang Dreyer. For both authors he was a very important source of knowledge as well as a partner for fruitful discussions on the topics of continuum mechanics and thermodynamics, especially concerning phase transitions.

arxiv-2503-23095.title: Memory-Aware and Uncertainty-Guided Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
arxiv-2503-23095.creator: Yuelyu Ji, Rui Meng, Zhuochun Li, Daqing He
arxiv-2503-23095.description: Abstract . Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to retrieve and reason over multiple pieces of evidence. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made progress in this area, existing methods often suffer from two key limitations: (1) fixed or overly frequent retrieval steps, and (2) ineffective use of previously retrieved knowledge.

pmc-11460365.title: An uncommon cause of epigastric pain in a child: falciform ligament appendigitis
pmc-11460365.creator: Raja Tamiru Muleta, Nibretu Bekele Kassa, Tazebew Tilahun Alamneh
pmc-11460365.description: Falciform ligament is a double fold of the peritoneum which has fat attached to it. The torsion of this fat leads to appendigitis which is a rare cause of acute severe epigastric pain. A 7-year-old boy presented with severe epigastric pain and vomiting of 3 days duration with associated epigastric tenderness.

pmc-11482277.title: Noise in the operating room coincides with surgical difficulty
pmc-11482277.creator: Sarah Peisl, Daniel Sánchez-Taltavull, Hugo Guillen-Ramirez, Franziska Tschan, Norbert K Semmer, Martin Hübner, Nicolas Demartines, Simon G Wrann, Stefan Gutknecht, Markus Weber, Daniel Candinas, Guido Beldi, Sandra Keller
pmc-11482277.description: BackgroundNoise in the operating room has been shown to distract the surgical team and to be associated with postoperative complications. It is, however, unclear whether complications after noisy operations are the result of objective or subjective surgical difficulty or the consequence of distraction of the operating room team by noise.

pmc-12709692.title: Impact of delayed sternal closure and negative pressure therapy after complex cardiovascular surgery
pmc-12709692.creator: Katheryne Chaparro Mendoza, María Paula Cortés Salas, Sergio Alzate-Ricaurte, Natalia Plata-Ayala, Mabel Soraya Moreno, Akemi Arango Sakamoto, Juan Manuel Maldonado, Jossman Javier Carvajal
pmc-12709692.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the safety of delayed sternal closure with negative pressure therapy in complex cardiovascular surgeries, with a focus on infectious complications, compared to primary sternal closure.MethodsThis retrospective observational study analyzed 285 adult patients undergoing complex cardiovascular surgeries between January 2019 and February 2021 at a quaternary care hospital.

pmc-12988738.title: Machine Learning Models for Predicting Antipsychotic Effectiveness and Separate Cost-Effectiveness Analysis in Hospitalized Schizophrenia Patients
pmc-12988738.creator: Jiatong Zhang, Qian Xu, WenLong Jiang, DaWei Sun, LongYan Peng
pmc-12988738.description: PurposeSchizophrenia is a burden on patients’ health and finances and long-term antipsychotic treatment is required; treatment response differs among patients. This study aims to leverage data from Chinese hospitals to develop a machine learning (ML) model that predicts antipsychotic treatment efficacy in patients with schizophrenia and to conduct a payer-perspective cost-effectiveness analysis to inform clinical practice.

pmc-13049029.title: Multi-objective sizing and location of DG in distribution network by hybrid gorilla troops optimization-genetic algorithm: a real case study
pmc-13049029.creator: Abdelmalek Gacem, Mabrouka Romdhane, Ridha Kechida, Ali Kechkhouche, Mohamed Naoui, Yasser Almalaq, Mansoor Alturki, Abdullah Albaker, Ayoob Alateeq, Tawfik Guesmi, Alessandro Bosisio
pmc-13049029.description: The efficient incorporation of distributed generators optimal DG in distribution networks represents a fundamental strategy for ensuring economical and efficient power system operation. The optimal DG problem can be described as a Mixed Discrete-Continuous Optimization Problem (MDCOP). In this study, a new hybrid approach combining Gorilla Troops Optimization and Genetic Algorithm, namely the Hybrid GTO-GA, is proposed.

pmc-13433143.title: Encroachment on Water Corridors Drives Farmers–Giraffe Conflicts Along River Tana Ecosystem in Eastern Kenya
pmc-13433143.creator: Mohamed H Ali, George Muriuki, Abdullahi H Ali, Harun Gitari
pmc-13433143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Human–wildlife conflict (HWC) is an escalating global issue that is influenced by climate change, human population growth, and agricultural expansion. In arid and semi‐arid lands (ASALs) such as Garissa County in Kenya, where resource scarcity intersects with expanding human land use, the effects of HWC are particularly severe, threatening the survival of species like the reticulated giraffe ( Giraffa reticulata ).
